node_types.name: Patient
node_types.business_meaning: Tenant-scoped synthetic subject; not a FHIR logical resource or global person identity.

properties.name: namespace
properties.business_meaning: Project privacy/purpose namespace.

properties.name: patient_key
properties.business_meaning: Wholly synthetic pseudonym; not FHIR id or a reidentification secret.

node_types.name: PatientIdentityLink
node_types.business_meaning: Evidence-bearing decision mapping a source Patient record to a project pseudonym.
node_types.identity_scope: Project decision id for this export

properties.name: link_id
properties.business_meaning: Source decision id, preserved for replay.

properties.name: logical_patient_ref
properties.business_meaning: Canonical source-server/Patient/id identity.

properties.name: decision
properties.business_meaning: accepted/rejected/unresolved from authorized crosswalk policy.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.business_meaning: Authorized crosswalk evidence reference; no secret matching material.

properties.name: authorized_for_purpose
properties.business_meaning: Local purpose authorization decision; not consent/compliance proof.

properties.name: decision_time
properties.business_meaning: Time of mapping decision, not patient birth or event time.

node_types.name: ResourceVersion
node_types.business_meaning: Immutable authorized source snapshot with source identity and record version.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: Canonical source URL/type/id/_history/versionId; exact case and opaque version preserved.

properties.name: logical_key
properties.business_meaning: Source endpoint plus resourceType/id; never patient pseudonym.

properties.name: source_server
properties.business_meaning: Canonical source base endpoint; no credentials.

properties.name: resource_type
properties.business_meaning: Original FHIR resourceType.

properties.name: resource_id
properties.business_meaning: Original server-local resource id.

properties.name: version_id
properties.business_meaning: Opaque record version from meta.versionId; absence blocks version-key publication.

properties.name: fhir_release
properties.business_meaning: Serialization baseline 4.0.1, distinct from record/terminology versions.

properties.name: last_updated
properties.business_meaning: Source meta.lastUpdated if known; not clinical event time.

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.business_meaning: Project ingestion instant, labeled separately from source clocks.

properties.name: current_claim
properties.business_meaning: Source-export current-state assertion, checked for contradictions.

properties.name: snapshot_hash
properties.business_meaning: SHA-256 of canonical example resource; conflicting same key is rejected.

properties.name: source_payload
properties.business_meaning: Authorized original source fields, retaining choice type/precision/unmapped extensions without asserting their semantics.

node_types.name: Encounter
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned interaction context, retaining repeated visits.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to exact ResourceVersion; a new version is not a new encounter.

properties.name: status
properties.business_meaning: Original encounter status; finished does not complete an order.

properties.name: period_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original period boundaries and precision; no fabricated timestamps.

node_types.name: Order
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned ServiceRequest: requested act, never automatic evidence of performance.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to ServiceRequest ResourceVersion.

properties.name: status
properties.business_meaning: Original request status; R4 revoked denotes cancellation.

properties.name: intent
properties.business_meaning: Request intent such as proposal/order; retained independently of status.

properties.name: code
properties.business_meaning: Original CodeableConcept, all codings/system/version/code.

properties.name: authored_on_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original authoredOn dateTime precision and timezone; no requested/performed substitution.

properties.name: occurrence_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original occurrence[x] name/type/value for requested schedule.

properties.name: do_not_perform
properties.business_meaning: Original ServiceRequest.doNotPerform modifier. True prohibits the named service; absent has the R4 positive-request default. Preserve original absence without manufacturing an action.

node_types.name: Observation
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned result assertion; retained even when not eligible for a quantitative view.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to Observation ResourceVersion; corrected versions remain separate snapshots.

properties.name: status
properties.business_meaning: Original modifier result status; entered-in-error is excluded as usable evidence.

properties.name: code
properties.business_meaning: Original complete code structure; display is not identity.

properties.name: value
properties.business_meaning: Original value[x] name/type/value including Quantity value/comparator/unit/system/code. No guessed normality.

properties.name: data_absent_reason
properties.business_meaning: Original reason for absent root value; never a numeric zero or negative result.

properties.name: effective_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original effective[x] choice and temporal precision; biological/event relevance.

properties.name: issued_at
properties.business_meaning: Availability of this result version, separate from effective and source update time.

node_types.name: Procedure
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned documented activity, including not-done/error states.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to exact Procedure ResourceVersion.

properties.name: status
properties.business_meaning: Original event status; local completed view admits completed only.

properties.name: code
properties.business_meaning: Original activity code; no clinical treatment recommendation.

properties.name: performed_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original performed[x] choice; permits dateTime/Period/Age/Range/string without invented precision.

node_types.name: Condition
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned recorded health concern/assessment; not generated by this model.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to exact Condition ResourceVersion.

properties.name: clinical_status
properties.business_meaning: Source clinical state, independent of assertion verification.

properties.name: verification_status
properties.business_meaning: Source confidence/verification state; unconfirmed is not confirmed.

properties.name: code
properties.business_meaning: Original assertion code; no derived diagnosis.

properties.name: onset_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original onset[x] with choice and precision.

properties.name: recorded_date_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original recordedDate; distinct from onset and intake recorded_at.

node_types.name: Provenance
node_types.business_meaning: Versioned documentation provenance; not proof of authorization or medical performance.
node_types.identity_scope: Source server/type/id plus opaque versionId; no demographic identity

properties.name: version_key
properties.business_meaning: FK to exact Provenance ResourceVersion.

properties.name: target_refs
properties.business_meaning: Exact source target references; versionless ones require documented resolution.

properties.name: activity
properties.business_meaning: Original provenance activity code; not a clinical act status.

properties.name: occurred_raw
properties.business_meaning: Original occurred[x] temporal choice when supplied.

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.business_meaning: Provenance.recorded in source; not project ResourceVersion.recorded_at.

properties.name: agent_refs
properties.business_meaning: Original agent references; no implied access grants.

edge_types.name: IdentityMapsPatient
edge_types.business_meaning: Accepted authorized identity decision links to exactly one scoped pseudonym.
edge_types.identity_scope: Exact source version plus source field path/index and resolved target key; repeated references/events not collapsed

properties.name: edge_id
properties.business_meaning: Deterministic source-version/field/index/target identity.

properties.name: source_path
properties.business_meaning: Source field path or project crosswalk field.

properties.name: original_reference
properties.business_meaning: Original reference retained for audit; absent only for project mapping edges.

properties.name: resolved_version_key
properties.business_meaning: Exact version selected by resolution; missing resolution produces no factual edge.

properties.name: recorded_at
properties.business_meaning: Reference resolution/intake instant, not a clinical event time.

properties.business_meaning: Source field path or project crosswalk field.

constraints.subject: node:PatientIdentityLink
constraints.rule: Project mapping rule: publish identity association only for accepted decision with nonempty approved evidence_id and authorized_for_purpose; shared demographics/contact cannot authorize a merge.

constraints.subject: node:ResourceVersion
constraints.rule: Exact source_server/resource_type/resource_id/version_id replay is idempotent; unequal payload hashes under the same key are rejected. Different servers/types/ids/versions survive. Missing versionId needs a distinct documented intake snapshot policy before publication.

constraints.subject: node:ResourceVersion
constraints.rule: At most one current_claim per logical_key in a view; zero is unresolved. Never choose current state by lexical/numeric versionId or arrival time. Retain historical snapshots and explicit current selection.

constraints.subject: node:Order
constraints.rule: Project counting rule: do not synthesize a Procedure from any request status/intent. R4 revoked order is cancelled. A separately documented completed Procedure survives subsequent order revocation; not-done is retained but not counted completed. Preserve doNotPerform negation: true is a prohibition, not an instruction to perform; absent has the R4 positive-request default. No source prohibition is converted to a positive act.

constraints.subject: node:Observation
constraints.rule: Official status boundary: entered-in-error is invalid evidence. Project quantitative view additionally requires current final/amended/corrected numeric valueQuantity, no comparator, known system/version/code and coded unit. Unknown/preliminary/missing values are not negative or normal.

constraints.subject: node:Observation
constraints.rule: Selected official R4 invariant obs-6: root dataAbsentReason may occur only when root value[x] is absent. Invalid pair quarantines the record; no silent repair.

constraints.subject: node:Observation
constraints.rule: Project comparison rule: aggregate only matching code system/version/code and Quantity.system/code without conversion; preserve comparator, original units/precision. Unknown version/unit prevents comparison, not evidence of normality.

constraints.subject: model
constraints.rule: Preserve authored/requested/performed/effective/issued/onset/source-recorded/source-lastUpdated/intake times and raw type/precision independently. Partial dates remain partial; intake is not a substitute for clinical time.

constraints.subject: node:Condition
constraints.rule: Preserve clinicalStatus versus verificationStatus; unconfirmed is not confirmed. Check selected official con-5 (entered-in-error omits clinicalStatus) and con-4 when abatement is supplied. No diagnoses are inferred from observations.

constraints.subject: node:Provenance
constraints.rule: Project policy: preserve version-targeted audit history; provenance alone never grants access or changes result validity. Apply retraction only with authorized exact-version instruction, independently of source entered-in-error status.

constraints.subject: model
constraints.rule: Purpose authorization is a precondition for ingest/use. Disclosure requires a separate authorization; synthetic example approval grants no real-system operation. No patient-system connection or production write is authorized.

constraints.subject: model
constraints.rule: Versioned references select exact snapshots. Versionless relative references resolve only within the same canonical source server to one authoritative current version as of intake; cross-server references require explicit base. Record resolution; unresolved/ambiguous targets do not create factual edges.

mappings.source_term: Resource.id + meta.versionId with canonical source base
mappings.explanation: Source record and opaque version identity are explicit; project patient identity is a separate construct.

Patient node is a scoped pseudonym; source Patient versions remain ResourceVersion snapshots linked through authorized evidence. Demographics and actual identifier secrets are outside this minimal projection.
Selected context/status/period only; class, hospitalization, participants and history remain source snapshot fields without implemented semantics.

Order is a graph name; only selected request fields/references are projected. Timing repetition, performers and full request workflow are not implemented. doNotPerform negation is explicit; unmodeled modifier extensions require quarantine/review before use, not raw-retention-only approval.
Root quantity view only. Components, interpretations, reference ranges, specimens and other value choices require additional explicit mapping; not inferred or clinically evaluated.
Preserves event status/performed choice/reference; not full performer, complication, body-site or clinical semantics.
Preserves assertion statuses/code/onset/recordedDate; not all stages, evidence or terminology semantics.
Selected targets/activity/agents/recorded only; no signature validation, trust scoring, AuditEvent or access-control implementation.
Original JSON preserves system/version/code, quantity comparator/unit code and choice; no terminology equivalence or conversion supplied.

mappings.source_term: Full profiles, modifierExtensions, conformance and jurisdiction rules
mappings.explanation: Raw snapshot retention is not semantic support. Validate actual source resources/profiles and approve missing mappings before deployment.

assumptions: Only wholly synthetic offline input is authorized for this example. No clinical or patient-system operation is included.
R4 4.0.1 is a deliberate published baseline; no R5/development-build equivalence is asserted.
Export envelope is_current is an authoritative synthetic current-version claim as of as_of; opaque versionIds are not sorted.
The fixture contains partial resource examples, not a FHIR Bundle or conformance-valid resource test suite.
For this example, current completed Procedure counts as documented completion; no act is inferred from an order, encounter or Provenance.
No terminology mapping, unit conversion, diagnosis inference or threshold-based clinical interpretation is authorized.
Relative references resolve against the envelope source_server and the selected current version at intake; resolution is captured explicitly.
unresolved: Real deployment must select jurisdiction, profiles, authorized purpose, terminology releases, missing-version identity policy, subject matching governance and access/retention/retraction controls.
The minimal quantity view omits component observations, complex effective/performed schedules, signatures and unmodeled modifier extensions; these require additional design/validation.
competency_questions: Which explicit completed Procedure records support fulfillment of a given requested act, and which requests are revoked, missing results or unresolved?
Which current result versions are quantitatively usable under the local data policy, with their event, issue and intake clocks?
Which earlier values were corrected or entered in error, while keeping source evidence intact?
Which repeated encounters and cross-server records remain distinct?
Which comparisons are blocked by missing coding versions, unknown values or unequal unit codes?
Which exact authorized evidence supports each patient mapping and each provenance/retraction target?
